C-01.mechanism: Requirements carry stable IDs; tests cite them

C-02.mechanism: ADRs append-only, acceptance recorded per decision

C-03.mechanism: Security review recorded before a contract is frozen

C-04.mechanism: STRIDE threat model mapped to spec IDs and tests

C-07.mechanism: Honesty ledger as a governance control

C-10.mechanism: Event keys: P-256 in Android Keystore, StrongBox when present, non-exportable (V7)

C-11.mechanism: Salts and nonces from java.security.SecureRandom only, never JS (V7)

C-12.mechanism: PIN checked on device with Argon2id; hash in Keystore-wrapped storage; pin_authorised bound to one action and target (§9)

C-13.mechanism: Foreground service type built from granted permissions; no start from background; no boot receiver (V2, V10)

C-14.mechanism: Only the launcher activity is exported; every other component exported="false"

C-15.mechanism: allowBackup="false" and data-extraction rules exclude the queue and keys

C-16.mechanism: usesCleartextTraffic="false"; network security config trusts system CAs only

C-18.mechanism: Raw audio is never written to storage; only label and basis-point score leave the classifier (RICA bright line)

C-19.mechanism: No PIN, salt, payload, token or location in Log.*; release build strips debug logs

C-20.mechanism: Permissions limited to the judge-build list in spec §11; never CAMERA, SEND_SMS, ACCESS_BACKGROUND_LOCATION, RECEIVE_BOOT_COMPLETED

C-21.mechanism: One canonicaliser, shared/canonical.js; no floats; ASCII keys; safe integers (§5)

C-22.mechanism: DER → raw r‖s only in shared/der.js (§5.7)

C-23.mechanism: No secrets in the JS bundle (it is extractable). Server credentials never ship in the app

C-24.mechanism: No eval, new Function or dynamic require

C-25.mechanism: Normal and duress PIN code paths share one render, one haptic, one request builder and one response wait (V5)

C-26.mechanism: No guardian acknowledgement on the member's phone during an open incident; incident events hidden from My Record until close (V8)

C-27.mechanism: Exact dependency versions (no ^ or ~) and a committed package-lock.json

C-30.mechanism: Order of checks: authenticate → event_id idempotency → nonce, counter, skew → append (§7)

C-31.mechanism: Signed statement binds domain, subject, actor, target, action, source time, key id, counter, event id and commitment (§4, B1)

C-32.mechanism: Deadlines from server receipt time only; window limited to 20 s or 60 s (§7, B4)

C-33.mechanism: Outcome row locked (SELECT … FOR UPDATE); first terminal outcome wins; outbox in the same transaction (§8)

C-34.mechanism: Parameterised SQL only; no string-built queries

C-35.mechanism: Request models reject unknown fields and floats

C-36.mechanism: Object-level authorisation on every /v1/subjects/{id}/… path: the key must belong to that subject (API1)

C-37.mechanism: Rate limits on invites (per subject, device, IP), recovery and public endpoints (G1, API4)

C-38.mechanism: Uniform error bodies; no stack traces; no personal data in logs

C-39.mechanism: Constant-time comparison for codes and hashes (hmac.compare_digest)

C-40.mechanism: Payloads and salts stored apart from the chain and encrypted at rest; deletion removes only them (P1)

C-41.mechanism: Server response bytes and timing for normal and duress results identical; outbox work runs after the response (V5, S3)

C-42.mechanism: Export PIN-gated and never reveals an open incident to the device (proposed fix for gap TM-C9)

C-43.mechanism: Post-recovery 24 h freeze extends to bulk export (S4)

C-50.mechanism: The export never leaves the browser: no upload, no analytics, no third-party script

C-51.mechanism: CSP default-src 'none'; script-src 'self'; connect-src 'self' <pinned mirror host>; style-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data:; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none' PROPOSED

C-52.mechanism: Export content rendered with textContent only, never innerHTML

C-53.mechanism: Pinned network, topic id and key-manifest fingerprint built into the page; mirror bytes decoded and compared with the recomputed root (§6, B2)

C-54.mechanism: Three honest states: live-verified, archived ("archived — not independent"), unavailable (§10)

C-55.mechanism: WebCrypto for SHA-256 and P-256; no home-made crypto

C-60.mechanism: Actions pinned by commit SHA; permissions: contents: read; persist-credentials: false

C-61.mechanism: Document contracts and claim safeguards in CI

C-62.mechanism: Contract tests (node --test) run in CI. Gap: 10/10 pass locally, but checks.yml does not run them FACT

C-63.mechanism: Branch protection requiring CI and non-author review

C-64.mechanism: CODEOWNERS auto-requests security review on contracts/, server/, shared/, dashboard/

C-65.mechanism: Release APK built from a tag; sha256 published with the release (D1, T20)

C-70.mechanism: Lockfiles committed: package-lock.json; Python requirements with hashes; Gradle dependency verification

C-72.mechanism: Pinned toolchain: Node, Python, JDK 17, RN 0.74. Today team/START-HERE.md states minimums ("Node 22 LTS or newer"), not pins; add engines in package.json and .python-version

C-73.mechanism: Model-weights manifest with sha256; the app verifies the digest before loading; input shape asserted from get_input_details() (V3)

C-74.mechanism: Gitleaks binary pinned by version and sha256

C-75.mechanism: SBOM (CycloneDX) for the APK and server

C-80.mechanism: Pre-commit gitleaks scan of staged content; refuses commits if gitleaks is missing

C-81.mechanism: CI scans full history and worktree

C-82.mechanism: Hook failure behaviour tested in isolated fixtures

C-83.mechanism: .env, keys, keystores, service-account files, *.tflite, data files git-ignored

C-84.mechanism: Runtime secrets (Hedera submitKey, server Ed25519 key, FCM service account, SMS key) only in App Service settings or a local .env; never in chat, issue or PR

C-85.mechanism: Two distinct operators sign signing-key rotation, operator deletion and threshold changes (ADR-0036(8))

C-86.mechanism: APK signing keystore held by Vukosi and Mutarisi only, backed up offline; never committed

C-100.mechanism: ZAP baseline on staging API and verify page, report kept

C-101.mechanism: Active scan (zap-api-scan.py against the OpenAPI file) on staging only

C-102.mechanism: MobSF static scan of the release APK

C-111.mechanism: TLS certificate pinning in the app

C-121.mechanism: 15-minute tabletop of one leaked-key and one location-leak scenario

C-130.mechanism: Operator-contract gap disclosed; no new live partner without a clause

C-131.mechanism: Correction propagation: design-open, with the s57 conflict named

C-132.mechanism: Only the six mapped labels leave inference; T41 on the feature-complete APK

C-133.mechanism: Account-matching flow documented; no real bank without a legal decision

C-134.mechanism: No marketing on the safety channels

C-139.mechanism: Guardian list without last-alert times, under the hold; abuse test
